description: Lateral portal test: from the widest point of the internal transmembrane cavity, cast 180 in-plane rays outward and record the largest probe radius that could travel from the cavity to the bilayer, comparing PTM1, TMEM87A (8CTJ), rhodopsin (1U19) and KcsA (1BL8), plus the identity of the PTM1 residues lining the widest portal
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
 'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'SE':1.90}
def parse_txt(txt, chains=None, resmin=None):
    rows=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')): continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ch=line[21]
        if chains and ch not in chains: continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        try: resi=int(line[22:26])
        except: continue
        if resmin is not None and resi<resmin: continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip(); el=(line[76:78].strip() or nm[0]).upper()
        if el in ('H','D'): continue
        rows.append((ch,resi,AA3[rn],nm,el,float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['ch','resi','aa','atom','el','x','y','z'])
def get(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=90); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text

af=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P32857',timeout=90).json()
S={}
S['PTM1 (AF P32857)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get(af[0]['pdbUrl']),resmin=27),
    tm=[('A',198,218),('A',231,251),('A',266,286),('A',305,325),('A',334,354),('A',382,402),('A',418,438)])
S['TMEM87A (8CTJ)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/8CTJ.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',229,249),('A',262,282),('A',297,317),('A',330,350),('A',359,379),('A',407,427),('A',439,459)])
S['Rhodopsin (1U19)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1U19.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',35,64),('A',71,100),('A',107,139),('A',151,173),('A',200,225),('A',247,277),('A',286,309)])
S['KcsA channel (1BL8)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1BL8.pdb'),chains=set('ABCD')),
    tm=[(c,23,51) for c in 'ABCD']+[(c,86,119) for c in 'ABCD'])

def axes(df,tm):
    vs=[]
    for ch,a,b in tm:
        s=df[(df.ch==ch)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))].sort_values('resi')[['x','y','z']].values
        if len(s)<5: continue
        v=s[-1]-s[0]; vs.append(v/np.linalg.norm(v))
    vs=np.array(vs); ref=vs[0]; vs=np.array([v if v@ref>0 else -v for v in vs])
    ax=vs.mean(0); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
    tmp=np.array([1.,0,0]) if abs(ax[0])<0.9 else np.array([0.,1,0])
    e1=np.cross(ax,tmp); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(ax,e1)
    tmca=np.vstack([df[(df.ch==c)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))][['x','y','z']].values for c,a,b in tm])
    return ax,e1,e2,tmca.mean(0),tmca

rows=[];portal_lin={}
for k,v in S.items():
    df=v['df']; X=df[['x','y','z']].values; rv=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in df.el.values])
    ax,e1,e2,cen,tmca=axes(df,v['tm']); tree=cKDTree(X)
    zt=(tmca-cen)@ax; zlo,zhi=np.percentile(zt,15),np.percentile(zt,85)
    # 1. widest interior point in the mid-membrane slab
    g=np.arange(-14,14.01,1.0); U,V=np.meshgrid(g,g); UV=np.c_[U.ravel(),V.ravel()]
    UV=UV[np.linalg.norm(UV,axis=1)<=14]
    best=(-1,None,None)
    for z in np.arange(zlo,zhi+.01,1.5):
        P=cen+np.outer(UV[:,0],e1)+np.outer(UV[:,1],e2)+z*ax
        d,i=tree.query(P,k=25); r=(d-rv[i]).min(1)
        j=int(np.argmax(r))
        if r[j]>best[0]: best=(r[j],P[j],z)
    rmax,C,zbest=best
    # 2. cast 180 in-plane rays out of that point; portal radius = max over rays of min free radius on the path
    th=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,180,endpoint=False); t=np.arange(0.5,24.01,0.5)
    prof=[]
    for a_ in th:
        dvec=np.cos(a_)*e1+np.sin(a_)*e2
        P=C+np.outer(t,dvec)
        d,i=tree.query(P,k=25); r=(d-rv[i]).min(1)
        prof.append(r.min())
    prof=np.array(prof); jb=int(np.argmax(prof))
    rows.append(dict(structure=k,widest_interior_radius=round(float(rmax),2),
                     portal_radius=round(float(prof.max()),2),
                     n_rays_ge_1_8=int((prof>=1.8).sum()),n_rays_ge_2_5=int((prof>=2.5).sum())))
    if k.startswith('PTM1'):
        dvec=np.cos(th[jb])*e1+np.sin(th[jb])*e2; P=C+np.outer(t,dvec)
        idx=tree.query_ball_point(P,6.0); s=set()
        for ii in idx: s.update(df.iloc[ii].apply(lambda q:q,axis=0).index[0:0])  # placeholder
        flat=sorted({int(q) for sub in idx for q in df.iloc[sub].resi.values})
        aa=dict(zip(df.resi,df.aa))
        portal_lin['PTM1']= [f"{aa[r_]}{r_}" for r_ in flat]
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\nPTM1 residues within 6 A of the widest lateral portal path:")
print(", ".join(portal_lin['PTM1']))

fig,axx=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
axx[0].bar(T.structure,T.widest_interior_radius,color=['#1f77b4','#2ca02c','#7f7f7f','#d62728'])
axx[0].set_ylabel('widest interior free radius (A)'); axx[0].set_title('Mid-membrane interior cavity width')
axx[0].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=20,labelsize=8)
axx[1].bar(T.structure,T.portal_radius,color=['#1f77b4','#2ca02c','#7f7f7f','#d62728'])
axx[1].axhline(2.0,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); axx[1].text(-0.4,2.1,'acyl chain ~2.0 A',fontsize=8)
axx[1].set_ylabel('largest probe reaching the bilayer (A)'); axx[1].set_title('Lateral portal from cavity to lipid')
axx[1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=20,labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
